top_findings.title: requirements.txt omits Flask — documented setup fails in a clean env
top_findings.evidence: requirements.txt lists only `pytest==7.4.3`; app.py:5 `from flask import Flask, ...`. README.md:22-30 instructs `pip install -r requirements.txt` then `python app.py`, which raises ModuleNotFoundError: flask on a fresh install. (Scored run passed only because flask was already present: test_coverage=0.94.)
top_findings.suggestion: Add `Flask>=3.0` (and pin it) to requirements.txt so the documented run instructions work reproducibly.
